readme.html:
Document Processing Skills

English | 中文

A collection of Claude Code / Codex skills for document manipulation — PDF extraction/forms, Excel analysis/formulas, Word, and PowerPoint.

Quick start

Claude Code, as a plugin

Two commands inside Claude Code, no cloning:

/plugin marketplace add appautomaton/document-SKILLs
/plugin install document-skills@appautomaton-skills

Skills are then invoked as document-skills:pdf, document-skills:docx, and so on. The system tools under Dependencies are still required; the docx and pptx skills install their Node packages the first time they need them.

Any agent, via symlinks

[!TIP] Clone this repo anywhere you keep your skills, then symlink each skill into your agent's skills directory.

git clone https://github.com/appautomaton/document-SKILLs.git ~/skills/documents
cd ~/skills/documents

# Claude Code
for s in docx pdf pptx xlsx; do
  ln -s "$(pwd)/$s" ~/.claude/skills/$s
done

# Codex
for s in docx pdf pptx xlsx; do
  ln -s "$(pwd)/$s" ~/.codex/skills/$s
done

Skills

Skill What it does
docx Create, redline, comment on, and read Word documents — real tracked changes, checked so no edit goes untracked
pdf Extract text/tables, fill fillable and flat forms, merge/split/stamp, OCR scanned pages
pptx Build decks from HTML as native slides, fill templates, duplicate and reorder slides, edit speaker notes
xlsx Create/edit workbooks with live formulas, then recalculate and get every error, circular reference, and broken function by cell

Every workflow checks its own output before handing it back: workbooks are recalculated and scanned for errors, Word and PowerPoint files are validated against the OOXML schemas, and documents, PDFs and decks are rendered so the agent can look at them.

Dependencies

[!NOTE] Python scripts use uv + PEP 723 inline metadata — no virtual environments or pip install needed. Just uv run.

System tools:

# macOS: one command via the repo Brewfile.
# Installs uv and node only if missing, optional tools are commented in the file.
brew bundle

# Linux
sudo apt-get install -y pandoc poppler-utils libreoffice
sudo apt-get install -y tesseract-ocr   # optional, OCR of scanned PDFs

Node.js packages (docx and pptx skills only):

cd docx && npm install
cd ../pptx && npm install

Development

tests/ runs every script through uv run, the way an agent does. See AGENTS.md.

skills.name: docx
skills.description: Create, edit, review, and read Word documents (.docx), including tracked changes (redlines), comments, footnotes, tables, images, headers and page setup. Use when a task produces or modifies a .docx, reviews or redlines one, or needs its text, comments or tracked changes read.

skills.name: pdf
skills.description: Read, create, fill, and transform PDF files. Covers extracting text and tables, OCR of scanned pages, filling fillable and flat forms, and flattening, merging, splitting, rotating, stamping and encrypting. Use when a task takes a .pdf as input or must produce one.

skills.name: pptx
skills.description: Create, edit, and analyze PowerPoint decks (.pptx). Build new decks from HTML slides, fill an existing template, duplicate or reorder slides, edit slide XML, and read or write speaker notes. Use when a task produces or modifies a .pptx file, or needs text, layout, or notes read from one.

skills.name: xlsx
skills.description: Create, edit, analyze, and recalculate Excel workbooks (.xlsx, .xlsm) with live formulas, formatting, and charts. Use when a task produces or modifies a spreadsheet file, turns CSV/TSV data into one, or needs values, formulas, or formatting read from one.
